from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate_with_moderator = operator.DebateWithModerator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            moderator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            agent_prompts=[prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_DEBATE_AGENT_PROMPT] * 3,
            moderator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_DEBATE_MODERATOR_PROMPT,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        solution = await debate_with_moderator(problem)
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

CAMPSITE_DEBATE_AGENT_PROMPT = """Solve the campsite puzzle.

Puzzle:
{problem}

Round: {round}
Moderator guidance:
{moderator_input}

Other proposals:
{all_proposals}

Requirements:
- Preserve every X exactly in place.
- Place * only on existing . cells.
- Satisfy the total tents and every row and column count exactly.
- Every tree must have at least one orthogonally adjacent tent, and every tent must be orthogonally adjacent to a tree.
- No two tents may touch horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
- Compare your board against other proposals and fix any count, adjacency, or missing-tree errors you notice.
- Before the final board, include exactly one short audit line in this form:
Audit: rows=[ok/not ok], cols=[ok/not ok], total=[ok/not ok], trees=[ok/not ok]
- Never output placeholders, apologies, missing-grid text, or requests for the puzzle.
- Always output a completed board, even in revision rounds.

Output exactly:
Solution: [one short sentence]
Audit: rows=[ok/not ok], cols=[ok/not ok], total=[ok/not ok], trees=[ok/not ok]
Final Board:
<begin_board>
[board]
<end_board>
"""

CAMPSITE_DEBATE_MODERATOR_PROMPT = """You are moderating agents solving the same campsite puzzle.

Puzzle:
{problem}

Round: {round}
Agent outputs:
{all_proposals}

If is_final is false:
- Identify the most likely concrete errors in the proposals: wrong row counts, wrong column counts, wrong total tents, tents touching diagonally, tents not adjacent to trees, or trees left without any orthogonally adjacent tent.
- Give a short correction note telling agents to repair those exact issues.
- Instruct agents to distrust any board whose audit says not ok on any field.
- Forbid fallback text such as "please provide the puzzle grid", "cannot determine", placeholders, or any non-board response.
- Output only the moderator note.

If is_final is true:
- Select or synthesize the best board, prioritizing proposals whose audit says all ok and whose board is consistent with the puzzle.
- Do not output analysis or commentary.
- Do not output None, placeholders, or requests for the puzzle.
- Return exactly:

Solution: [one short sentence]
Final Board:
<begin_board>
[final board]
<end_board>
"""
